R314_violation: 25 mmHg was misattributed as 'CLINICAL threshold, AANS Brain Trauma Foundation'. This is WRONG. BTF 22 mmHg is for severe TBI, not hydrocephalus.
R315_correction: 25 mmHg = MODELLED ENGINEERING THRESHOLD pending hydrocephalus-specific clinical justification. BTF recommendation documented as TBI evidence only.

15_mmHg.rationale: Conservative lower bound — mild ICP elevation

20_mmHg.rationale: Common upper limit of normal ICP (5-15 mmHg resting, up to 20 with postural changes)

22_mmHg.rationale: BTF severe TBI treatment threshold. NOT hydrocephalus-specific.

25_mmHg.rationale: Moderate engineering threshold. R314 default. NOT clinically validated for hydrocephalus.

30_mmHg.rationale: Conservative upper bound — severe ICP elevation requiring intervention

frozen_criterion.robustness_requirement: P-19 advantage must persist across >= 4 of 6 thresholds to be considered robust
